_doc: The numbers mcgyvr sizes and judges a machine with that it cannot read off the machine or the model. The `numbers` block holds them, and every entry of it is an estimate: a starting value shipped with mcgyvr, not a reading of your machine. Each is keyed by something every machine has (an engine, a unit's tolerance class), never by a machine's name. To use your own value, write it in numbers.yaml in mcgyvr's own folder (~/.mcgyvr/numbers.yaml), under the number's name and then its key, for example `prefill_class_pct:` and below it `vllm: 12`; your value replaces the estimate. A number of this block that neither file states is refused by name: none of them falls back to a default in code. The `constants` block says what each number still written in mcgyvr's code is, for every number that sizes, judges, refuses, waits or picks: a fact, a choice of mcgyvr (with the setting that changes it, or why there is none), or an estimate (with the number it will become in the `numbers` block). The `covered` block names every file of mcgyvr's code and says whether its numbers are classified in `constants`, or why not.

warm_decode_class_pct.estimates: How far, in percent, the warm decode speed of a healthy unit of this tolerance class may fall from one start of the unit to the next.
warm_decode_class_pct.used_for: A live probe that finds a unit's warm decode further than this below its locked warm decode pulls the combination the unit runs in, until that combination's validation is committed again. Writing a fleet's lock is refused when a unit's warm decode falls further than this below the baseline its evidence states for it.
warm_decode_class_pct.note: A starting value, not a reading of your machine. The spread between starts may differ with the engine version, the model and what else the machine is doing.

prefill_class_pct.estimates: How far, in percent, the prefill speed of a healthy unit of this tolerance class may fall from one start of the unit to the next.
prefill_class_pct.used_for: A live probe that finds a unit's prefill further than this below its locked prefill pulls the combination the unit runs in, until that combination's validation is committed again.
prefill_class_pct.note: A starting value, not a reading of your machine. The spread between starts may differ with the engine version, the model and what else the machine is doing.

runtime_resident_gb.estimates: Host memory, in GiB, that a llama.cpp server holds beyond the expert weights it keeps in host memory.
runtime_resident_gb.used_for: Added to the host memory a unit is sized to need when some of its experts stay in host memory; charged only then.
runtime_resident_gb.note: A starting value, not a reading of your machine. It may differ with the model and the context size.
